{{Quote|This is the MX&hellip; I heard about it. They're using ion-flow as a power source. It'll clean off a quarter-deck in half a millisec.|Mandalore the Indomitable|<ref name="TSW2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 2]]</ref>}}
A '''Millisecond''' was a unit of [[Time/Legends|time]] and represented a thousandth of a [[Standard second|second]].
